name: Reedhaven
dialogue: Our raised cottages keep the marsh at bay. I trade swamp boots: wear them to reach dark swamp ground and gather 20% more herbs.
residents: The remedies at Willow Still are running low. A herb shipment vanished along the lantern causeway; Fen last saw its boat.
I mend flat-bottomed boats at Reedworks. The missing herb boat had a split pole; someone may have taken shelter at the old sluice.
I keep the causeway lanterns lit. One went dark the night our herb shipment disappeared. Sedge worries about the travelers waiting for medicine.
A loose reed basket drifted past the old sluice. Bracken recognized its weave from the missing shipment.
Sedge taught me to dry willow leaves at Willow Still. I saved a little medicine for the boat crew, if they return.
The Lantern Rest keeps a warm bed for every lost traveler. Nessa and I are listening for word of the missing herb boat.

name: Sunwell
dialogue: Welcome to Sunwell. The dunes stretch beyond our sandstone homes. I trade desert clothing: wear it to gather 20% more berries.
residents: Our spice caravan is late. Its last message mentioned the buried mile markers beyond Sunwell. Amir knows the old route.
I repair the well and caravan stones. A sandstorm covered the route markers; Safiya fears the caravan followed the wrong ridge.
I keep water ready at the Sunwell cistern. The overdue caravan carried spare well ropes; Zara is saving provisions for its return.
I found a strip of caravan cloth near a buried marker. Idris remembers where the older road crossed the dunes.
At Dune Loom I dye cloth bright enough to see through blowing sand. Rafi brought back a torn strip in our caravan colors.
The Amber Rest has empty beds waiting for Safiya’s caravan. Their last letter spoke of a sheltered ruin beside the old road.

name: Frostbrook
dialogue: Our snowy village is a warm stop on the ice fields. Stay awhile and rest before your next journey.
residents: The northern watchpost has stopped lighting its beacon. Eira is keeping our hearth warm for the wardens when they return.
I split timber at Pineworks. The watchpost asked for a new beacon frame before the blizzard; Boreal still has their message.
I saw tracks leading away from the silent watchpost toward the frozen brook. Siv hopes the wardens found shelter.
The watchpost beacon guides travelers across the ice. Hakon and I are checking the old trail for fallen branches.
I keep blankets ready at Snowthread. Yrsa found a warden’s scarf by the brook; its owner may be waiting out the storm.
The Hearth Rest has hot broth for anyone coming off the ice. Leif promised to bring news from the silent watchpost.
